paragraphs: Rav Chama—the reading before us is Rav Acha, and Ein Yaakov reads Rav Chisda. Rav Acha bar Yaakov said concerning him, “The world has been handed over to fools,” because he did not know how to answer King Shapur's question, “Where is burial derived from the Torah?”: Sanhedrin 46b. Ein Yaakov reads “Rav Acha bar Yaakov said to him,” while the Gemara reads “Rav Acha bar Yaakov said.” Apparently “to him” is a scribal error, because it says there, “He should have said, etc.” If he were speaking to him, as “said to him” implies, it should have said “You should have said.” “R. Chama said: R. Elazar said”—Taanit 16b. Ameimar said in Rav Chama's name. I do not know who this Rav Chama is.
